scientific_integrity: All claimed identities independently derived by explicit polynomial factorization; the motivating arXiv manuscript was withdrawn on 2026-02-25 after its own main theorem was found incorrect. The withdrawn theorem is not used.
scientific_limitations: Universal conclusion is restricted to degrees two and three; the degree-four statement is one counterexample, not a classification. No assertion about intersections over all additive shifts or any degree above four.
title: Degree four is the first obstruction to critical-value sampling of polynomial root hulls
